serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: ZevaCrypt is an end-to-end email encryption solution utilizing government PIV/CAC cards and the Public Key Infrastructure in a way that makes end-to-end encryption intuitive. ZevaCrypt works with Outlook as a plug-in that allows for the discovery of the recipient’s public key through a SaaS-enabled eDirectory and uses policies and validations to manage the ability to send and received emails from authorized Agencies. ZevaCrypt was designed to support inter-department encryption communication using the existing infrastructure.
